body_markdown:
[SkyMiles](https://news.delta.com/category/skymiles)


# Delta and Hyatt launch new benefits and experiences for SkyMiles® and World of Hyatt members


Elevated travel, exceptional rewards. Delta SkyMiles® and World of Hyatt are bringing their new long-term strategic relationship to life with connected benefits designed to reward members across more of their travel journey.


Staff Writer


Nov 16, 2026 9:15am


Delta and Hyatt’s new long-term strategic relationship launches today, bringing eligible Delta SkyMiles® and World of Hyatt members new ways to earn and access benefits across both programs when they link their accounts at[delta.com/WorldOfHyatt](https://www.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/how-to-earn-miles/skymiles-partners-offers/hyatt) .


First[announced](https://news.delta.com/delta-and-hyatt-introduce-new-strategic-relationship) in September, the relationship brings together two leading brands to help connect the air and hotel experience, with a shared ambition to create more value and recognition across the travel journey. Together, Delta SkyMiles and World of Hyatt are creating a more connected experience that recognizes members and rewards them for their travel and what they’ve earned across both brands.


“At Delta, we know loyalty is something we earn by delivering meaningful value and experiences that make our Members want to keep choosing us,” said Dwight James, S.V.P. – Customer Engagement & Loyalty and CEO, Delta Vacations. “Our relationship with World of Hyatt gives us another way to do that by recognizing and rewarding Members across more of their travel, while creating new ways to earn, engage and experience both brands.”


“World of Hyatt and Delta SkyMiles were each built to make travel more meaningful and rewarding, which makes this collaboration feel meant to be,” said Laurie Blair, Senior Vice President, Global Marketing and Loyalty, Hyatt. “By connecting the Delta flight and Hyatt stay, we are helping members get more from the journeys they are already taking while opening the door to new experiences, destinations and memories. It is an exciting next step in our commitment to caring for members throughout the full travel journey, from takeoff to check out.”


Read on to discover what the new relationship means for Members and how to start taking advantage of the benefits today.


**AT A GLANCE:**


-


###### **Link your accounts to get started:** All members can connect their SkyMiles and World of Hyatt accounts to access eligible offers and experiences.


-


###### **Discover double the benefits:** Eligible Medallion Members and World of Hyatt elite members can earn across qualifying Hyatt stays and Delta flights.


-


###### **More ways to turn loyalty into rewards in 2027:** Qualifying linked members in both programs can select new rewards from the other program as they reach eligible milestones.


-


###### **Limited-time offers for linked members:** Linked members can access special earning opportunities to celebrate the launch.


-


###### **Enter for a chance to win the ultimate Delta x World of Hyatt getaway:** SkyMiles Members can enter through SkyMiles Experiences for the chance to experience the best of both brands on a special getaway to Alila Mayakoba in Riviera Maya. (NO PURCHASE NECESSARY; see details below*)


###### **NO PURCHASE OR PAYMENT NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. Open to legal residents of the 50 U.S./D.C., age 21+. Void outside the 50 U.S./D.C. and where prohibited. Sweepstakes starts at 6:00:00 AM ET on 11/17/2026; ends at 11:59:59 PM ET on 11/23/2026. Odds of winning depend on the number of entries received. See full Official Rules for details at delta.com/groupdrop.*


###### *Sponsor: Delta Air Lines, Inc., 1030 Delta Blvd., Atlanta, GA 30354.*


### Link your accounts to get started


SkyMiles and World of Hyatt Members can visit[delta.com/WorldOfHyatt](https://www.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/how-to-earn-miles/skymiles-partners-offers/hyatt) today to link their accounts and take advantage of eligible benefits, including the new **Dual Earn** benefit where Delta Medallion Members can earn miles on stays and World of Hyatt elites can earn points on flights (see details below).


All members, regardless of status, can link their accounts to access limited-time offers and experiences, including special opportunities celebrating the launch. Linking also keeps accounts connected, making it easier to discover and take advantage of other eligible offers and benefits as they become available.


*Already a member of both programs? Start by logging in to your SkyMiles Account to link your accounts. Not yet a member? Join*[SkyMiles](https://www.delta.com/joinskymiles/) *and*[World of Hyatt](https://world.hyatt.com/content/gp/en/program-overview.html) *for free, then link your accounts*[here](https://www.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/how-to-earn-miles/skymiles-partners-offers/hyatt) ***** to get started.*


### Discover double the benefits


Your journey is made of flights and stays, and now your rewards can come from both.


Once accounts are successfully linked, eligible Medallion Members can earn miles on qualifying Hyatt stays, while elite World of Hyatt members can earn Bonus Points on qualifying Delta premium cabin flights.


Eligible Members include Delta Diamond, Platinum, Gold and Silver Medallion Members, as well as World of Hyatt Discoverist, Explorist Globalist and Lifetime Globalist Members.


Qualifying Delta premium cabin flights include Delta Comfort, Delta Premium Select, Delta First Class and Delta One. All Delta fare experiences, including Basic, Classic and Extra, are eligible when purchased in an eligible premium cabin.


See how it works:


Status Benefits & Earning


**SkyMiles® Medallion Members**
**(Diamond, Platinum, Gold and Silver)** Earn 1 mile per $1 of eligible spend at participating Hyatt® hotels and resorts


**World of Hyatt® Discoverists** Earn 1 World of Hyatt point per $2 of eligible spend on qualifying Delta premium cabin flights


**World of Hyatt® Explorists** Earn 1 World of Hyatt point per $1 of eligible spend on qualifying Delta premium cabin flights


**World of Hyatt® Globalist** Earn 1 World of Hyatt point per $1 of eligible spend on qualifying Delta premium cabin flights


Exclusions apply, including taxes and other fees. Other terms and restrictions apply. See[terms](https://delta.com/us/en/skymiles/how-to-earn-miles/skymiles-partners-offers/hyatt#termsandconditions) for details.


### More ways to turn loyalty into rewards in 2027


The relationship expands further in 2027, with new ways for qualifying members to choose rewards across both programs.


Beginning Feb. 1, 2027, with the start of the 2028 Medallion Year, qualifying SkyMiles Members will also have new ways to turn their loyalty into memorable World of Hyatt stays. Through Delta Choice Benefits, eligible Members can select World of Hyatt Free Night Awards as a 2028 Medallion Year Choice Benefit, including:


- A Category 1-4 Free Night Award as a **Platinum Choice Benefit**
- A Category 1-7 Free Night Award as a **Diamond Choice Benefit**


And beginning Jan. 1, 2027, World of Hyatt members can choose from a range of Delta awards as they reach qualifying Milestone Rewards thresholds. The first Delta award choice will become available at 20 qualifying nights or 35,000 Base Points, with additional choices as members progress through the program, including:


- Delta e-certificates in varying amounts at milestones from 20 to 60 qualifying nights
- Two Single Visit Delta Sky Club® passes at 70, 80 and 90 qualifying nights
- Opportunities to receive Delta Medallion Status (without access to Choice Benefits) at milestones from 100 to 150 qualifying nights


Together, the new choices give members more ways to use the loyalty they’ve earned with one brand toward travel with the other.


### Limited-time offers for linked members


***Earn 1,000 Delta miles and 1,000 World of Hyatt points:*** To celebrate the launch, Delta and Hyatt are introducing a series of limited-time offers for members who link their accounts.


- All Linked Members can earn 1,000 Delta miles on their first stay at a participating Hyatt® hotel and resort completed between Jan. 4, 2027 and Feb. 15, 2027.
- All Linked Members can earn 1,000 World of Hyatt points on their first flight on an eligible Delta premium cabin completed between Jan. 4, 2027 and Feb. 15, 2027.


See terms for eligibility, exclusions, and other[terms and conditions](https://si.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/how-to-earn-miles/skymiles-partners-offers/hyatt#termsandconditions) .


### Enter to win the ultimate Delta x World of Hyatt getaway


What better way to bring Delta and Hyatt’s new relationship to life than by getting away together?


Also beginning today, SkyMiles Members can visit[SkyMiles Experiences and enter the Group Drop](https://www.skymilesexperiences.com/iSynApp/playInstantWin!showInstantPlay.action?sid=1101601&selectedItwName=delta-hyatt-groupdrop&mkcpgn=dwb-h0ygcw) and enter with a friend for the chance to escape to[Alila Mayakoba](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/cunam-alila-mayakoba) , part of Hyatt’s Luxury Portfolio, in Riviera Maya, Mexico from Jan. 22-25 – no miles or point required to enter. The retreat’s carefully curated experiences and the choice to follow your own pace make every moment feel effortless.


The journey includes an immersive curated experience, an intimate evening as the sun goes down, and a Delta lounge pop-up that’s yours to drop in throughout your stay at Alila Mayakoba.


**Members who link their SkyMiles and World of Hyatt accounts before entering the sweepstakes will be eligible for one additional entry to win. See terms below.**


Bringing together the best of both brands, the getaway is designed to showcase a shared approach to delivering premium travel experiences, with the kind of thoughtful hospitality, memorable moments and sense of discovery that are uniquely Delta and Hyatt.


*The benefits launching today are just the start of Delta and Hyatt’s shared ambition to make travel more connected and rewarding, bringing together the best of both brands across more of the journey. For full benefit details, eligibility requirements and terms and conditions, visit*[delta.com/WorldOfHyatt.](https://www.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/how-to-earn-miles/skymiles-partners-offers/hyatt) **
